headline: KIR reports typed checks for agent-authored building models, with direct-code comparison still open
summary: A September 2026 preprint introduces KIR, a typed intermediate representation and compiler for agents authoring building information models in Revit. On a pinned KIR 0.8.1 snapshot, the author reports offline checks across 83 operation contracts, including typed refusals for 29 of 42 stress-test programs, 38 named absences among 377 witness obligations, and no vacuous certificate in 219 program-version runs. These are paper-reported results from project-authored artifacts; native Revit runs are separately reported from project records. The paper specifies but has not run a same-model, same-budget comparison against agents writing Revit code directly, and it demonstrates only Revit as an execution backend.
